SECPRE Certified Plastic Surgeons · Teknon Group

Facial Surgery: Real Harmony, Intact Expression

 The goal of facial surgery is not to change a face. It's for your face to reflect what you feel. To improve signs of aging that drain your energy. To harmonize proportions that have always bothered you. Or to regain definition that time has blurred. At Clínica Belba, we plan each procedure based on each patient's facial anatomy with plastic surgeons SECPRE certifications, precise surgical technique, and results that look natural because they are designed to be so.

Our Surgeons

Plastic surgeons specializing in facial surgery

At Clínica Belba, we don't work with general practitioners. Our team is exclusively made up of plastic surgeons, reconstructive, and aesthetic. All of our surgeons are SECPRE certified, maintaining Spain's most demanding professional standard.

Dr. Mike Dewever

Plastic, reconstructive, and aesthetic surgeon

 «"The best surgery is the one decided upon calmly, based on medical judgment and realistic expectations."»

Specialist in body and facial surgery with a precise and respectful approach to each patient's anatomy. In the field of breast surgery, they apply advanced mammoplasty techniques that prioritize tissue preservation, natural-looking results, and safety throughout the entire process, with continuous medical follow-up from the first consultation to the last check-up.

Dr. Marel Gómez

Especialista en procedimientos de estética facial y corporal

«Every patient is unique. Listening and accompanying are part of the outcome.» 

Specializing in aesthetic breast surgery with a personalized, natural-results-oriented approach. Your priority is ensuring every breast surgery decision is fully informed, taking care of both the aesthetic outcome and the patient's well-being and peace of mind before, during, and after the procedure.

Dr. Laura Torrano Romero

Plastic, reconstructive, and aesthetic surgeon

Specialist in plastic and reconstructive surgery with specific experience in breast and lymphedema units in Barcelona hospitals. Trained at the University of Navarra with international internships at Stanford and Mayo Clinic. Doctoral candidate in microsurgery and author of scientific publications in the field of reconstructive breast surgery. One of the few plastic surgeons in Spain with combined training in aesthetic and oncological breast surgery.

Dr. Félix Chavarría

Plastic, reconstructive, and aesthetic surgeon

It's not about doing more surgery, it's about doing the right surgery.» 

With extensive experience in plastic and reconstructive surgery, he stands out for his medical judgment and conservative approach when the case allows. In breast augmentation, he utilizes techniques that reduce surgical impact, minimize recovery time, and promote a controlled postoperative evolution, always within the safe hospital environment of Grupo Teknon and Hospital Tres Torres.

Meet the full team of surgeons

SECPRE Certification

Why it matters who performs your facial surgery and where your surgery is done

In facial surgery, be it liposuction, an abdominoplasty or one Mommy Makeover  The plastic surgeon's experience and certification make the difference between a natural-looking result and one that is not. The face is the most visible area of the body, and there is no room for error in facial surgery. But there is a second, equally decisive factor: the surgical environment where the procedure is performed.

At Clínica Belba, we work with a double standard of safety: SECPRE-certified plastic surgeons operating in the operating rooms of the Teknon Group and the Tres Torres Hospital two of the most renowned private hospitals in Spain and all of Europe.

Grupo Teknon and Hospital Tres Torres: where each facial surgery is performed

All facial surgeries at Clínica Belba are performed at the Teknon Group and the Tres Torres Hospital. Teknon Group is one of the most prestigious private hospitals in Europe, with over 500 specialist physicians, operating rooms equipped with state-of-the-art technology, and international healthcare quality accreditation. Hospital Tres Torres complements our surgical offerings with the same high standards. When you have surgery with us, you are not having surgery at a conventional cosmetic clinic. You are having surgery at a hospital.

  • State-of-the-art operating rooms with cutting-edge technology
  • International Health Quality Accreditation
  • 24-hour multidisciplinary medical team
  • Anesthesiologists specializing in facial surgery
  • Immediate responsiveness to any post-surgical contingency

What is facial plastic surgery?

Facial plastic surgery encompasses surgical procedures aimed at improving the aesthetics, structure, and proportion of the face. It can help treat signs of aging, excess skin, sagging tissues, eyelid bags, nasal deformities, loss of jawline definition, prominent ears, altered earlobes, or facial disharmony.

Unlike facial aesthetic medicine treatments such as Botox, hyaluronic acid, and biostimulation, facial plastic surgery acts on deeper structures and allows for the correction of anatomical changes that do not respond to non-surgical treatments.

Every face is different. Planning must be personalized and carried out by a medical team specialized in facial surgery.

Treatments

Types of facial surgery at Belba Clinic

Breast surgery is not a single procedure. It is a set of surgical interventions — each with its own specific indication, technique, and recovery process — that our plastic surgeons master with the same level of expertise. Whether you are looking for breast augmentation, reduction, lift, or correction of a previous surgery, the starting point is always the same: an individualized medical evaluation where your surgeon assesses your case, explains your options, and honestly tells you what makes the most sense for you.

Facelift

Facelifts are indicated for patients with significant sagging, tissue ptosis, or loss of definition in the face and neck. Their goal is to reposition facial tissues and achieve a more rejuvenated and fresh appearance without altering natural expression. It is the most impactful facial surgery procedure for overall aging of the mid and lower thirds of the face and neck. Facelift

Deep plane facelift

The Deep plane facelift It is an advanced facial rejuvenation technique that works on deeper planes than conventional facelifts. It allows for the repositioning of tissues in a more natural and lasting way, avoiding the tight appearance associated with more superficial techniques. It is indicated for more pronounced aging or when a more complete and lasting correction is sought. Facelift

Mini facelift

 A mini facelift may be indicated for patients with mild to moderate sagging who are seeking to improve facial definition with a less extensive approach than a full facelift. The surgical time and recovery are shorter, although the results are also more limited—something our surgeons explain clearly during the consultation. Mini facelift

Blepharoplasty

The Blepharoplasty It allows treating excess skin on the upper eyelids, bags under the lower eyelids, or a tired look that doesn't reflect how you feel. It is one of the most requested facial surgery procedures due to its direct impact on the expression and freshness of the face — with a relatively quick recovery compared to other facial procedures. Blepharoplasty

Rhinoplasty

La rinoplastia permite modificar la forma, tamaño o proyección de la nariz para mejorar su proporción con el resto del rostro. Puede tener un objetivo estético, funcional o ambos. Es uno de los procedimientos de cirugía plástica facial más complejos, porque pequeños cambios en la nariz tienen un impacto muy visible en la armonía global del rostro. View rhinoplasty

Nose remodeling

Nose remodeling is a non-surgical aesthetic medicine treatment that allows for the improvement of small details of the nose through injections, without going under the knife. It can correct minor irregularities or improve the nasal profile in selected patients seeking a subtle change. It does not replace rhinoplasty when significant nasal structure modification, volume reduction, or functional problems need to be addressed. → See rinomodeling

Otoplasty

Otoplasty corrects prominent or protruding ears, improving facial proportion and symmetry. It is a facial surgery with a real impact on patient confidence and a relatively comfortable recovery. It can be performed from adolescence onwards. → See otoplasty

Lobuloplasty

Lobuloplasty allows for the correction of torn, elongated, or deformed earlobes — due to heavy earrings, accidental tears, or simply the passage of time. It is an outpatient minor facial surgery procedure, performed under local anesthesia with a very quick recovery, which has a more significant aesthetic impact than might appear at first glance. → See lobuloplasty

Facial fat grafting

Facial fat grafting uses the patient's own fat to restore volume in areas of the face that have lost it over time: cheekbones, nasolabial folds, under-eye hollows, or areas with loss of support. The result is natural because it's the patient's own tissue, and it has the advantage of combining facial rejuvenation with discreet reshaping of the donor area. Check availability for medical assessment

Chin surgery

 Mentoplasty allows you to improve chin definition, facial profile balance, or the harmony between the jaw, nose, and other facial structures. It's a procedure with a significant impact on the overall proportion of the face — especially in profiles where the chin is retracted or not well-defined. → See mentoplasty
What facial surgery do I need?

Objective

  • Rejuvenate face and neck with significant sagging
  • Improve mild or moderate sagging
  • Correct droopy eyelids or bags
  • Improve nose shape and proportion
  • Non-surgical minor nose correction
  • Correct protruding ears
  • Ear lobe correction
  • Restore lost facial volume
  • Chin or profile enhancement

Standard treatment

  • Facelift
  • Mini facelift
  • Blepharoplasty
  • Rhinoplasty
  • Nose remodeling
  • Otoplasty
  • Lobuloplasty
  • Facial fat grafting
  • Mentoplasty
This table provides guidance, but the final decision is always made after an in-person medical evaluation.

From query to retrieval

What is the process of your facial surgery: from consultation to recovery

1

Personalized medical evaluation

Your plastic surgeon analyzes your facial structure, skin quality, facial proportions, signs of aging, and your realistic expectations. They will honestly explain the available options: what surgery can achieve, what it cannot, and what makes the most sense for your specific case.


2

Surgical planning

Once the decision is made, the specific surgical plan is designed. The necessary preoperative tests are requested: blood work, electrocardiogram, and any others that may be required. The technique, hospital setting, and date of surgery are confirmed.


3

The intervention at Grupo Teknon or Tres Torres Hospital

All facial surgeries at Clínica Belba are performed in the operating rooms of Grupo Teknon and Tres Torres Hospital – SECPRE plastic surgeons, specialized anesthesiologists, and multidisciplinary follow-up. Not in a conventional aesthetic clinic.


4

Postoperative follow-up

We conduct scheduled check-ups to monitor progress, address any questions, and ensure the outcome is developing well. Post-operative care for facial surgery has its own specific requirements—sun protection, hygiene, and rest—which our team details precisely for each procedure.
First consultation also available via video call — for patients outside of Barcelona

Risks

What you should know before your facelift surgery: risks and preoperative information

At Clínica Belba, we believe medical transparency is part of care. Like any surgical intervention, facial surgery carries risks that are important to know before making a decision—and our plastic surgeons explain them to you in detail during the pre-operative consultation. Here, we give you an overview.

Most frequent (they resolve themselves during the first few months in the vast majority of cases)

  • Inflammation and bruising in the operated area
  • Temporary changes in skin sensitivity on the face or neck
  • Transient asymmetry during recovery
  • Tightness or a feeling of stiffness in the first few weeks after a facelift

Less common

  • Temporary alteration of facial mobility. Uncommon with an expert plastic surgeon and appropriate technique.
  • Hypertrophic or keloid scar, depending on individual predisposition
  • Residual asymmetry, controllable with correct postoperative follow-up
  • Infection, treatable with the corresponding medical protocol.

Prices

How much does facial surgery cost in Spain?

The price of facial surgery varies depending on the procedure, the complexity of the case, the technique, the type of anesthesia, the operating room, and the included follow-up. A blepharoplasty does not have the same cost as a rhinoplasty, a mini-lift, or a deep plane facelift with combined fat grafting.

At Clínica Belba, we conduct a personalized medical evaluation to define the most appropriate treatment and provide an adapted and transparent quote.

We offer financing. Check the conditions on your first visit → Ver precios de cirugías plásticas

Request a personalized quote
Testimonials

Patient testimonial

“I was afraid of scars and asymmetry, but after a month I was back to my normal life, and within two months there was barely a trace left.” 

“I looked at reviews, I saw photos, and that gave me the push to decide on the doctor.”

“They’ve always looked out for me; they’re a caring, professional team, and I recommend them 100%.” 

Happy Surgeon Chavarria
Plastic, reconstructive, and aesthetic surgeon

As plastic surgeons, scars concern us: that's why we place them behind the ear or within its natural folds

“In a facelift, the scar is placed in strategic areas around the ear so that, over time, it becomes practically invisible.” 

Claudia Abel
Patient testimonial

“I am very grateful to the clinic and for the trust the doctor instilled in me from the first day.” 

“It helped me find the nose I was looking for; the result is exactly what I expected.” 

“I am very happy with my rhinoplasty and I recommend Clínica Belba to everyone.”

Frequently Asked Questions

Frequently Asked Questions About Facial Plastic Surgery

Resolve your most common questions about breast augmentation surgery

What is facial plastic surgery?

 Facial plastic surgery encompasses surgical procedures aimed at improving the harmony, structure, or rejuvenation of the face: Facelift, Blepharoplasty, rhinoplasty, Otoplasty, lobuloplasty, Facial lipofilling and mentoplasty. It acts on deeper layers than aesthetic medicine and offers more durable and structural results.

¿Cuál es la cirugía plástica facial más demandada?

Among the most in-demand in Spain are the Blepharoplasty, the rhinoplasty and the Facelift. The choice always depends on the area to be treated and the individual medical assessment.

What is the difference between a facelift and a deep plane facelift?

The conventional facelift works on the more superficial layers of tissue. The deep plane facelift works on deeper planes, allowing for more complete repositioning of tissues with a more natural and lasting result. It is indicated for more pronounced aging. You can see more on our page Facelift

Is there a facelift without surgery?

 There are non-surgical treatments that tighten the skin superficially, such as threads, ultrasound, and radiofrequency, which in some contexts are referred to as «non-surgical facelifts.» Their results are more limited and temporary than those of a surgical facelift, especially in cases of significant sagging. Our surgeons will honestly explain which option makes the most sense for your case.

What results can I expect from facial surgery?

The results of a well-planned facial surgery are natural, harmonious, and long-lasting. Swelling takes several weeks to subside, and the final result can be seen between 3 and 6 months after the procedure.

When to consider a facelift?

When there is sagging of the face or neck, loss of jawline definition, tissue ptosis, or visible signs of aging that do not improve with non-surgical treatments. More information on the page Facelift

Does facial surgery change your expression?

A well-planned facial surgery should respect the patient's natural expression. The goal is to rejuvenate or harmonize the face, not to alter their identity.

How much does facial surgery cost in Spain?

The price depends on the procedure, the complexity of the case, the technique, and the included follow-up. The medical evaluation allows for a personalized and transparent budget.

Where are facial surgeries performed at Clínica Belba?

At Grupo Teknon and Hospital Tres Torres, with SECPRE certified plastic surgeons. We attend to patients from all over Spain and the first consultation is also available via video call.

  • If you are considering this surgery and want an honest medical opinion, request a personalized medical assessment.

Take the first step towards your facial surgery. Thoughtfully, calmly, and with no obligation.

Deciding on facial surgery requires time, real information, and a surgeon who speaks to you honestly. At Clínica Belba, your first medical consultation is free and without obligation: a meeting where your plastic surgeon analyzes your case, explains what surgery can and cannot do, and gives you a concrete and realistic proposal.

We see patients from all over Spain. The first consultation is also available via video call.
